summary: Defines Applicability Statement 2 (AS2), a way to exchange structured business data securely over HTTP, using MIME for packaging. The data may be XML, EDI, or other formats. It parallels the SMTP-based approach in RFC 3335 but sends data directly between peers over HTTP.

eli5.summary: Two companies want to mail each other secure order forms. This memo explains how to put the forms in a sealed envelope and deliver it straight over the web, so each side knows it arrived safely.

questions: how to send edi over http
mime based secure business data exchange
